projects.title: Instructor Training Platform
projects.summary: A production knowledge platform for the organization's instructors, designed, built and launched from scratch. Adopted by ~50 instructors within two months of launch.

media.alt: Sign-in screen of the Bartali instructor training platform
media.caption: Sign-in screen. The platform itself is behind a login.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.text: Instructors searched for training materials across scattered documents and had to download files to read them.

sections.heading: What I built
sections.text: A searchable, mobile-first knowledge platform that brings all training materials into one place, each item linked to its source document.

sections.heading: Features
list: Searchable library: Library, Safety and Quality Control sections
Cmd+K search across all content
Every item linked to its source document
In-app issue reporting
Multiple content editors and authenticated users
Mobile-first installable web app (PWA), Hebrew RTL

sections.heading: Architecture
list: Python / FastAPI backend with SQLite
PostgreSQL knowledge base with row-level security (RLS) access rules, KB schema and catalog
Content pipeline that feeds the knowledge base
Frontend in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript

sections.heading: Roadmap — v2.0 (planned / in progress)
list: Offline access
News feed
In-platform document forwarding with notifications
AI-generated training sessions built from the library
Repair-request workflow for the bike mechanic

sections.heading: My role
sections.text: Sole engineer, working directly with management and instructors. I also own the organization's digital services: the WordPress website (bartali.org.il), email newsletters and the SaaS tools staff use daily.

principles.title: Start from the user's problem
principles.text: Requirements usually come from non-technical people. I start with what they actually need, then choose the architecture and tools.

principles.title: Ship small, then iterate with real feedback
principles.text: Get a working core into people's hands early, then improve it based on how it's really used.

principles.title: Own it after launch
principles.text: Support, monitoring and fixes are part of the job. I stay responsible for the systems I ship.
